Provide project context and coding guidelines that AI should follow when generating code, answering questions, or reviewing changes.

## Content protection

Do not modify files under `content/`, including article text, Markdown headings,
titles, front matter, tags, categories, or dates, unless the owner explicitly
requests a specific content change. Technical work may change how content is
rendered, but it must not silently rewrite the source content. Ask for approval
before creating a technical system page under `content/`.
